name: fllm-agent
description: Start the fLLM coding agent, the spec workflow and the pull request review from VS Code (skeleton, runs fllm-rs in the terminal).

commands.title: fLLM: Run a task with the agent
fLLM: Ask about the selection (read only)
fLLM: Plan a feature as a spec
fLLM: Do the next task of a spec

fllm.executable.description: The fllm-rs program (a full path if it is not on PATH).

fllm.serverUrl.description: The running fLLM server (it must run on this computer).

fllm.allowEdits.description: Let the agent change files (--allow-edit). Off: it reads and answers only.

fllm.allowCommands.description: Let the agent run commands such as tests (--allow-command).
